remarks: COMPO BEACH LIFE....Welcome to 19 Sherwood Drive which has been nicely refreshed since it's recent purchase by the new owner. Situated in the heart of Westport's coveted Compo Beach community the photos show fresh paint, recently updated bathrooms, kitchen, and refinished floors. This spacious 4 br, 3 bath home is anything but typical! Enjoy year-round and carefree beach-life. One will never go wanting for activities, one can also just grab a towel sink into your own 8 person hot tub in privace or, stroll downthe street to stick your toes in the sand and just relax. Generously sized lot is perfect for entertaining without being too close to the neighbors.
